admission.justification: Document-keyed state prevents an expansion or own view from another task leaking into the selected task while avoiding destructive resets on ordinary refresh.

applicability: Local expansion/own-view state of a selected sprint/master/task document reader.
conditions: Selecting a different qualified TaskEntry.key (the repository/path document key) remounts TaskPage: the objective starts clipped, note/row disclosures closed and the main page selected.
A refresh of the same qualified entry key preserves open reader state; a new body object or body revision alone is not a new-document reset boundary.
exclusions: Resetting the panel scroll position on document navigation (separate deferred mark).
Changing task identity or durable state.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/selection-state.test.tsx: five tests; with the key taken out four fail and the same-document case passes (notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f6/checks/selection-tests-without-the-key.log)

statement: What a reader opened on a task page belongs to that document: the next document selected starts with its objective held, its note lines closed, its rows closed and its page instead of a view of its own, while the same document keeps what is open when its data arrive again.
